decidedBy: Claude, under data/identity-vocabulary-policy.json; no new ruling from Lou was needed
question: verify._warn_unresolved_lot_names() counts 50 lot-source supplier names across 25 frameworks that DO resolve to a Hub supplier record, but whose framework's own brief supplier list names no row reaching that record, so attach_names() has nothing to attach the lot to.
whatIsNotTheFix: "Re-read the brief" is not the general answer. On Hand Hygiene the brief states 21 suppliers and prints 21 while Find a Tender notice 000335-2023 awards 33; on Airway Management the brief prints 54 and states 54. Both captures are complete — the brief and its lot source genuinely name different supplier sets.
bar: data/identity-vocabulary-policy.json: two companies sharing a NAME is not evidence, two sharing a REGISTRATION NUMBER is; a name-search candidate cannot carry a merge; an alias may never link a related entity, because aliases drive award routing.

merged.folded: P.W.Coole & Son Limited T/A Surgical Holdings
merged.evidence: MERGED 2026-11-17 working the framework-lots residuals: the Hub held one company as two records, "Surgical Holdings Limited" and "P.W.Coole & Son Limited T/A Surgical Holdings". Companies House 03090951 SURGICAL HOLDINGS LIMITED, active, incorporated 14 August 1995, Unit 8 Parkside Centre, Potters Way, Temple Farm Industrial Estate, Southend On Sea, SS2 5SJ, records the dated previous name "P.W. COOLE & SON LIMITED" (14 Aug 1995 to 27 Aug 2025), read at Companies House 2026-11-17; data/company-financials.json already publishes 03090951 for this record at matchConfidence "confirmed". Both names are therefore names of ONE registration, which is the evidence data/identity-vocabulary-policy.json requires before two records become one — a shared registration number, never a shared name. A separate P.W.
